answer: Anyone running 195 aliases as a result needs 60 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in ferrous, expire in saffron, and harbor lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4773 identities would post 2921 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
